import_provenance.original_title: Fast dynamic vertex colouring against adaptive updates
import_provenance.original_statement: Can a randomized data structure maintain a proper (Δ+1)-vertex colouring in polylogarithmic expected amortized update time against an adaptive adversary? The graph undergoes edge insertions and deletions, always has maximum degree at most the known bound Δ, and vertex-colour queries should take constant time.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: Editorial adversarial-robustness extension: the constant-update result assumes oblivious updates; adaptive-adversary algorithms still had polynomial update bounds at the cutoff.
